contractEnforcements.hypothesisEngineScope: renderer/js/r3-0d-hypothesis-engine.js is the SINGLE new production path authorized at D3. It consumes ONLY a D2-authoritative Evidence Graph snapshot. Authority is enforced via a layered model: (a) input + opts snapshot at engine entry via descriptor-only reads (Codex D3 R2 R2-05 + D3 R3 R3-05 closure: accessors / non-enumerable / Symbol keys / function fields on input wrapper or opts fields rejected — including opts.clock which must be enumerable; opts.clock held by reference and invoked AT MOST ONCE); (b) deep-frozen requirement on input.graph via captured Object.isFrozen (Codex D3 R1 RN-08 closure); (c) HI.safeStructuredClone-defang of input.graph so subsequent reads use a plain non-Proxy snapshot; (d) HI.deepOriginalShapeAudit on the clone catches class-instance/Array-subclass/Symbol-key/accessor/sparse/non-finite-number smuggling; (e) recomputed graphId (FNV-1a 32-bit×2 byte-equivalent to D2) equality with asserted graphId rejects forged / opaque-Proxy / inconsistent graphs (Codex D3 R2 R2-04 closure: graph-level Proxy traps may fire during clone, but the engine only consumes the cloned values, and TOCTOU/opaque proxies fail the recompute check); (f) D2 invariant re-validation on the clone — no duplicate nodeId, every node.nodeId conforms to ID_RE (Codex D3 R2 R2-02 closure), cross-case/cross-session per-node identity scope, lap-mismatch rejection (Codex D3 R1 RN-06), imported_summary + measured rejection (Codex D3 R1 RN-04), full SourceIdentity invariants (sourceId/sourceVersion/lapId non-empty + byte cap — Codex D3 R3 R3-04 closure); (g) correlation partition reconstruction from node identity tuples via D2's exact _correlationGroupCanonical encoding (HI.stableStringify per component — Codex D3 R3 R3-01 closure for delimiter-collision-free key); D2's emitted correlationGroups must EXACTLY match the reconstructed partition; each correlationGroupId must conform to D2's grammar `corr_<16hex>`, be unique within g.correlationGroups, AND equal the D2-recomputed value `'corr_' + _hash64('corr|' + canonical)` (Codex D3 R3 R3-02 closure); independenceWeight uses Object.is exact 1/count equality (Codex D3 R2 R2-02 closure: NaN/Infinity rejected); (h) edge validation — every edge.from/edge.to references a known nodeId AND edge.kind is in the closed enum {supports, contradicts, derived_from, correlated_with, invalidates} (Codex D3 R3 R3-03 closure); (i) mandatory freshness enforcement — opts.clock() returning ISO 8601 OR opts.referenceNowMs must be supplied (fail-closed when absent, Codex D3 R2 R2-03 closure); per-node freshness must parse via captured Date.parse, default max age = 30 days (configurable via opts.maxAgeMs).
contractEnforcements.noLLM: No LLM call. No runtime config. No filesystem. Pure deterministic transformation.
contractEnforcements.noUI: No DOM mutation, no Alpine binding, no index.html script src. UI is exclusively D5_ENGINEER_BRIEF_ACTIVATION.
contractEnforcements.noRecommendation: D3 does NOT emit Recommendation objects (auto_tuning / auto_setup / auto_calibration / auto_preset / driver_action / user_initiated APPLY modes). Recommendation generation is exclusively D4_PRIORITY_ENGINE.
contractEnforcements.noCausalOverclaim: All hypothesis i18nKeys and alternative explanation i18nKeys live in the rule registry and are pre-vetted. The 6-category enum is preserved verbatim (data_quality / mapping_calibration / driver_behaviour / vehicle_response / setup_model / unknown). No driver_fault / guaranteed_fix / professional_diagnosis / fastest_setup / theoretical_best vocabulary appears anywhere.
contractEnforcements.closedRuleRegistry: RULE_REGISTRY is a deep-frozen array of rule objects declared at module init. No runtime registration; no string-eval; no Function constructor; no caller-supplied rule. New rules require a new module load and a new D-checkpoint Codex review.
contractEnforcements.deterministicOutput: Same authoritative graph (regardless of clock) → identical hypothesisSetId, identical hypothesis IDs, identical confidence states + scores, identical sorted order. Clock is INJECTABLE via opts.clock(); createdAt depends on the clock; hypothesisSetId is INDEPENDENT of the clock.
contractEnforcements.confidenceModel: Confidence state enum {not_computed, insufficient_evidence, low, moderate, high}. Auxiliary integer score 0..100 derived deterministically from independent supporting groups (with correlation-group dedup), aggregate credibility, contradictions, freshness. Caller cannot supply confidence; engine ignores any caller value. Duplicate evidence in the same correlation group counts ONCE.
contractEnforcements.credibilityLadder: Aggregate credibility uses CONCLUSION_CREDIBILITY ladder ['Physics','Model','Measured','Derived','Heuristic','Unavailable']. measured evidence → 'Measured'; derived → 'Derived'; heuristic/synthetic → 'Heuristic'/'Heuristic'; none → 'Unavailable'. Heuristic/synthetic credibility forces LIMITATION_HEURISTIC_ONLY / LIMITATION_SYNTHETIC_ONLY into the hypothesis limitations.
contractEnforcements.validationActionsClosedEnum: Closed kind enum from D1 hypothesis-contract.VALIDATION_ACTION_KIND_ALLOWED: {fix_data_quality, recalibrate_channel, controlled_repeat_lap, driver_experiment, setup_experiment, collect_additional_session, collect_additional_lap, no_action_required}.
contractEnforcements.alternativeExplanationsRequired: Every fired rule contributes at least one alternativeExplanation entry (closed per-rule list). Alternative IDs are content-derived (hypothesisId + altSuffix hash), deterministic, deep-frozen.
contractEnforcements.cannotConcludeStructured: When no rule fires across the whole graph, snapshotCannotConclude contains INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Codex D3 R1 RN-01 closure: D3 does NOT consume graph.cannotConclude or graph.limitations from the input graph (those fields are not bound to graphId); all snapshot.cannotConclude and snapshot.limitations are derived from rule firing outcomes. Caller cannot inject free-text reasons; only closed reason codes from REASON_CODES are emitted.
contractEnforcements.deepFreezeOutput: The returned hypothesisSet and every nested array/object is Object.freeze'd (via HI.deepFreeze). Caller mutation post-build cannot reach into the snapshot.
contractEnforcements.hardenedIntrinsicsEnforced: Every ambient intrinsic call goes through R3_0D_HardenedIntrinsics (HI). The validation path NEVER invokes attacker-replaced ambient intrinsics — that is the primary defence. The four integrity checkpoints (Step 0 entry, Step 3.5 per-rule, Step 7.5 post-clock, Step 9.6 post-freeze) are defence-in-depth on HI surface integrity (Codex D3 R2 R2-07 closure: claim narrowed). Hash function is byte-equivalent to D2 _hash64 (FNV-1a 32-bit twice, concatenated) so authoritative graphId recomputation matches exactly. Object.isFrozen, Date.parse, and Object.is are captured at module init as supplementary primitives not in the HI surface (Codex D3 R1 RN-08 + R2 R2-02 closure).
contractEnforcements.caps: HYPOTHESIS_COUNT_CAP=64, ALT_EXPLANATION_COUNT_CAP=128, VALIDATION_ACTION_COUNT_CAP=128, CANNOT_CONCLUDE_CAP=64, LIMITATIONS_CAP=64, SUPPORT_ID_PER_HYPOTHESIS_CAP=64, CONTRADICT_ID_PER_HYPOTHESIS_CAP=64, ALT_ID_PER_HYPOTHESIS_CAP=16, REASON_CODE_PER_HYPOTHESIS_CAP=32, STRING_BYTE_CAP=512, ENVELOPE_BYTE_CAP=512 KiB, GRAPH_NODE_INPUT_CAP=8192, GRAPH_EDGE_INPUT_CAP=16384. generationToken ≤ 128 chars; contextVersion ≤ 128 chars.
contractEnforcements.outerTryCatch: buildHypothesisSet is wrapped in an outer try/catch. Any internal throw collapses to INTERNAL_CONTRACT_VIOLATION via RC.buildBlockedResult; never bubbles to the caller.
contractEnforcements.privacyBoundary: Output never contains raw telemetry samples, filesystem paths, source filenames, usernames, machine IDs, internal database handles, stack traces, or Electron private paths. Tests assert no '/Users/' substring, no 'stack' key, no UUID-shape identifier in the serialized envelope.
contractEnforcements.scopeBindingFromGraph: caseAssociation and sessionAssociation in the hypothesisSet are copied verbatim from the authoritative graph (after Proxy-defang). Cross-case / cross-session evidence in the graph is rejected by the per-node identity scope check BEFORE any rule evaluates.
